hostile opener

Each probe row is one escape a file-opened view tries; each control row is one thing it may do, which must work. A host is safe when every probe says blocked and every control says ok; a check reads [data-probe], the same rules as tests/fixtures/mcp-apps' hostile view (docs/mcp-apps.md, the sandbox's checks; docs/plugin-apps.md A4, A5, Fixtures).
